definitions.gloss: chemical product; chemicals (reagents, industrial chemicals, or synthetic substances used in science, manufacturing, or cleaning)
definitions.explanation: chemical product; chemicals (reagents, industrial chemicals, or synthetic substances used in science, manufacturing, or cleaning)

examples.japanese: {化学|かがく}{薬品|やくひん}の{取|と}り{扱|あつか}いに{注意|ちゅうい}する。
{化学|かがく}{薬品|やくひん}は{鍵|かぎ}のかかる{場所|ばしょ}に{保管|ほかん}してください。
examples.english: Please store chemicals in a locked location.

examples.japanese: {工場|こうじょう}から{化学|かがく}{薬品|やくひん}が{漏|も}れ、{周辺|しゅうへん}{住民|じゅうみん}が{避難|ひなん}した。
examples.english: Chemicals leaked from the factory, and nearby residents evacuated.

notes:
A general term for substances produced through chemical processes, including laboratory reagents, industrial chemicals, cleaning agents, and other synthetic compounds. Common in safety instructions, environmental news, and scientific contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {化学|かがく}{薬品|やくひん}の{取|と}り{扱|あつか}い — handling of chemicals
- {化学|かがく}{薬品|やくひん}の{保管|ほかん} — storage of chemicals
- {有害|ゆうがい}{化学|かがく}{薬品|やくひん} — hazardous chemicals
- {化学|かがく}{薬品|やくひん}メーカー — chemical products manufacturer

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {薬品|やくひん} — chemicals; medicine (broader, includes pharmaceuticals)
- {試薬|しやく} — reagent (specifically for laboratory use)
- {化学|かがく}{物質|ぶっしつ} — chemical substance (more general/scientific)
- {劇薬|げきやく} — powerful/dangerous drug or chemical
